<thought>By testing possible tree configurations, I found that a simple series chain B – 20 Ω – N_d2 – 15 Ω – N_d1 – 10 Ω – X3 reproduces all six measured resistances:
- B‑N_d2 = 20 Ω
- N_d2‑N_d1 = 15 Ω
- N_d1‑X3 = 10 Ω
- B‑N_d1 = 20+15 = 35 Ω
- N_d2‑X3 = 15+10 = 25 Ω
- B‑X3 = 20+15+10 = 45 Ω
Thus the subnetwork consists of three resistors R1, R2, R3 in series connecting the terminals X3 and B as described.</thought>
